subject: english
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

Tortoises inhabit all of / the world's landmasses / except Australia / and Antarctica.
solution:
The erroneous part of the sentence is: **Tortoises inhabit all of.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Add** 'almost' after the word 'inhabit'** to make the sentence correct.</li&
